_doc: Enemy kinds (design/combat/enemy-combat-spec.md §2-§4, §6.4; build item N-6.1). tiers: the size of the numbers by tier (enemy spec §3); `break` is the Break meter's size (0: no meter, any hit staggers it). break: each hit adds `per_impact` × its Impact, +`behind` from behind and +`windup` while it winds up; full, the enemy is Broken for `broken_s` (by tier): it can't act and takes `broken_damage` × damage; the meter drains `drain`/s after `drain_after` s without a hit. director: at most `melee` melee and `ranged` ranged enemies may start an attack on you at once, and none further than `reach` px from you (the off-screen rule). states (N-6.2, enemy spec §5): fire that hits a unit whose body catches (data/materials.json fire × body) sets it burning for `burn_s` (× `tier_k` for big ones), `burn_dps` every `tick` s; flesh catches only when oiled (tar, `oil_s`), and oil makes it burn `oil_k` × as hard; a burning unit lights the ground it stands on and any husk within `spread_r`; water puts it out; `panic` factions run from you while they burn. kinds: one record per kind: faction, role, tier, attack (melee, ranged; duel and boss kinds aren't counted by the director), body material (data/materials.json: Hollows are husks, cloth; Silas flesh; the Warden iron; an ember is fire and takes no states), the lesson it teaches, then its numbers (hp, poise, speed, radius, damage, windup, reach or range, cooldown, xp, and per-kind keys).

hollow.lesson: Light and fire control a crowd.
hollow.name: Dust Hollow

slinger.lesson: Close in, or keep a lamp between you.
slinger.name: Hollow Slinger

inverted.lesson: Its stones fly home: stand off its line, not out of its reach.
inverted.name: Backward Slinger

rival.lesson: A duel: read his wind-ups and break them.
rival.name: Silas Vane

ember.lesson: Fire barely touches it; water puts it out.
ember.name: Ember
